title: The results are in
description: A choice turns into a small chart, with result fills and percentages moving together.
useCase: Reveal poll results after a vote while keeping the chosen option visible.
reducedMotion: Bars and percentages jump to their final values; the winner check appears without scaling.
limitations: Votes are local illustrative data. Replace them with server results and preserve the one-vote guard.
look: Pale olive-cream page with a narrow stack of three off-white rounded option rows, grey and sage fill bars, monospace percentages and olive captions.
motion: Voting springs each row's clip-path fill to its share while the percentage counts up with it and fades in; once settled, the winner's check pops in with a stiff spring.
adapt: `usePollResults` derives shares, winner and the one-vote guard; each `Row` animates a `motionValue` with the `FILL` spring into a `clipPath` inset and writes the percentage via `useMotionValueEvent`. Replace `OPTIONS` with server results; tune `FILL` and `POP`.
